findings.summary: Reuse the shared type/group expression unwrapper for awaited text exports.
Share constraint anchor normalization while retaining hinge and six-axis frame layouts.
Share the generated physics node world-matrix projection with character controllers.
Remove the obsolete generated hinge forwarding API and exercise the current constraint entry in its fixture.
Avoid registering supplemental controller methods twice in full mode.
Cache the eight font coverage tables and retain references during glyph rasterization.
Keep range bitmap textures when only opacity changes and rebuild only affected geometry.
Move fresh text layouts into retained runs instead of copying glyph vectors.
